title: Light Novel 'Tsuihou Sarete Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu' Gets TV Anime
content: Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced a television anime adaptation of Daken's Tsuihou Sarete Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu ( The Exiled Merchant Saves the World with the Power of Gold ) light novel on Friday.

title: One of Warner Bros’ Funniest Cartoons is Coming to Tubi
content: Tubi made some big news in recent days, confirming that some Cartoon Network heavy hitters were leaving its platform while other big series are set to arrive on the free-to-watch streaming service.

title: The Ribbon Hero Anime Film's Trailer Reveals 5 Cast Members, Previews English Dub
content: Netflix began streaming on Thursday the final trailer for The Ribbon Hero , Twin Engine 's new anime film based on Osamu Tezuka 's Princess Knight ( Ribbon no Kishi ) manga, and it previews the English dub .

title: Oni & Dawn's Hana Ikuta Launches New Manga
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Cune magazine revealed on Monday that Hana Ikuta will launch a new manga titled Noraware Yūsha to Tokitai Seijo (The Cursed Hero and the Saint Who Wants to Free Him) in the magazine's next issue on August 27. The fantasy romance manga centers on the hero Mikage.

title: My Life as Inukai-san's Dog Author Gosei Furukawa Launches New Manga
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Comic Alive magazine revealed on Monday that Gosei Furukawa will launch a new romantic comedy manga titled Jūmonji-kun Shika Mienai!! ( Juumonji in Sight! ) in Kadokawa 's Alive+ online magazine on August 23. The manga will launch with three chapters.
author: ANN

title: 'The Ribbon Hero' Reveals Supporting Cast, Third Trailer
content: The official website of the The Ribbon Hero original anime movie revealed supporting cast and a third trailer on Thursday. The anime movie based on Osamu Tezuka 's Ribbon no Kishi ( Princess Knight ) manga will premiere worldwide exclusively on Netflix on August 8.
author: MyAnimeList
